description: This Java source file defines a test class 'LoanRescheduleRequestTest' which extends 'BaseLoanIntegrationTest'. It contains automated integration tests for creating, approving, rejecting, and modifying loan reschedule requests within the Apache Fineract project. The class includes setup methods, helper methods for creating entities (clients, loan products, loans), and multiple test cases covering different scenarios for loan rescheduling functionalities.
